2:
Not really, I didn't come for anything in
particular... I just wanted to see how you
were doing.
3:
All the shops are closed, so I figured you
might be having trouble getting food and
stuff.
4:
If you come over to my place, I can at least
make you a meal, you know?
6:
Rest assured. I am carrying on exactly as
usual. I am not troubled in the least.
7:
The shops being closed has little to do with
me anyway.
9:
I am largely self-sufficient as it is. You
need not worry about me.
11: Maybe I'll give it a try
15: I do not believe I am doing anything special.
16:
Normally, with this many shops shut down,
people would be struggling to find food!
17:
...I suppose so. That is what is normal, I
imagine.
18: But this is a life I chose because I enjoy it.
19:
That it leaves me largely unaffected is
pure coincidence. I did not foresee a
situation like this.
20: Well, sure, nobody saw this coming.
21: Either way, I think it's amazing.
23: Maybe I'll give it a try too.
24:
You are interested in a self-sufficient
life?
25:
Yeah, kinda. It'd have been nice to have
some vegetables I could eat growing in my
yard.
27:
Tomatoes are in season from spring to
early summer and from autumn to early
winter. People tend to assume summer.
28:
At this time of year, the harvest should
already be over.
30:
Well, whatever you grow, the basics are
the same.
31: Would you like to try a little?
33:
Help me harvest the vegetables I am
growing.
34:
Are you sure? Isn't harvesting the most
fun part?
35:
Fun...? I wonder. You will find out once you
try it.
38: We are only halfway done, Tomoki.
40:
Senpai, you do this brutal stuff pretty
much every single day?!
41:
Not every day... but when the weather is
clear, I tend to the field.
42:
Most farm work is done half-crouched.
Keep at it, and you will soon get used to it.
43:
My back's gonna snap before I get used to
it. Ow ow ow...
44: Hmm... Well, that should do for now.
45:
Take those vegetables with you. With the
shops closed, you are the one who is in
trouble, Tomoki.
46:
Huh, really?! But you grew these
vegetables yourself, Senpai...
47:
There are good harvests and bad ones. I
cannot grow only exactly what I need. Any
surplus just goes back to the soil.
48:
So that's how it works. I'll gratefully take
them!
49: Come help again sometime, all right?
51:
(It's crazy hard work, so no way, never
again!)
52:
(Is what I'd like to say... but he did give me
vegetables~)
53: (Guess I'll at least work off what I got...)
56: Doesn't that mean... it's always a hassle?
57:
It's tough for you all the time, right?
Working the fields, catching fish...
58:
I have never thought of it as a hassle...
but it is true that staying alive takes a
great deal of effort.
59:
If you call that a hassle, then I suppose it
is.
60:
However, isn't what one considers a hassle
a matter of personal perspective?
61:
No, anyone could see it's a hassle.
There's no way I could live like this.
62:
...I see. That may be how the world at large
sees it, but this life suits me.
63:
Well, I do get the feeling it suits you,
Senpai...
